Willing to sign a consent form before your information is shared with the payment provider. No specific device is required, and we’ll provide instructions for the task. Time & Payment The active testing takes approximately 1 hour total . The bank transfer itself may take up to 2 business days to arrive. $18 USD/hour $100 USD completion bonus after successfully completing the testing requirements How To Test This You will be asked to create an account on our website in order to access the testing materials and track any issues with the app/payment transfer. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview The Marketing Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in supporting global marketing strategies by acting as the primary marketing execution partner for assigned regions. Sitting between the global marketing strategy team and local teams, this role translates campaign briefs into live, tracked, and measurable programs. The ideal candidate is highly active and responsive, managing regional website updates, executing end-to-end campaigns, and serving as the primary point of contact for regional marketing technology (Martech) requests. Reference: 2635-154124 Responsibilities Campaign Execution: Own and deploy regional campaigns end-to-end, including landing page updates, email programs, UTM tracking, registration flows, and post-campaign reporting. Global Alignment: Work closely with regional Growth Leads and Corporate Marketing Operations to align localized campaigns with global marketing calendars. Event Support: Facilitate and execute demand generation programs, events, and webinars for designated regions. Martech Management: Serve as the primary regional contact for Martech questions, tool access, and user requests. Platform Triaging: Coordinate, triage, and route platform-specific requests (e.g., ZoomInfo, Salesforce, website updates) to their respective owners. User & Seat Admin: Manage seat allocations, user access, and tool usage reporting for regional team members. Website Operations: Handle regional website update requests, including content edits, component modifications, URL changes, and UTM setups on Webflow and Salesforce. Salesforce Automations & Reporting: Build and manage Salesforce flows, automations, and custom reporting dashboards to track lead ingestion and campaign performance. Requirements Experience: 2 to 3 years

jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in Germany, France, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
